corrections_and_qualifications.source_reading: A probability-zero event X is paired with buying a unit-paying bet on X for one dollar as a purported fair transaction.
corrections_and_qualifications.active_treatment: Sell the X contract at zero, or buy the complementary contract at one; both give payoff minus the X indicator. The original contract was not fair at credence zero.

corrections_and_qualifications.source_reading: The pair 0.438 and 0.572 is called a closest coherent complementary credence pair.
corrections_and_qualifications.active_treatment: The pair sums to 1.010 and is not coherent. No intended replacement is guessed. The valid Euclidean pair is proved; absolute-distance minimizers and an explicitly specified extension of relative entropy give valid contrasting repairs.

corrections_and_qualifications.source_reading: Conditioning and Jeffrey conditioning are described as closest updates under relative entropy, Hellinger, and variation distance.
corrections_and_qualifications.active_treatment: Explicit finite proof fixes new-to-old relative-entropy orientation and shows unique KL/Hellinger minimizers but potentially nonunique total-variation minimizers. A counterexample is supplied.
Ordinary conditioning order invariance is restricted to fixed events with positive common intersection; Jeffrey noncommutativity is realized by two exact finite reset calculations.
